```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("clin_effect_figure_simplified_dag")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  funs = c("dag_helpers"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "dagitty", "ggdag", "ggtext"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r dag-simple-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
#| fig-cap: "Simplified causal DAG for METIMMOX-1 (unpublished). Solid arrows denote assumed causal effects. The dashed arrow indicates that the treatment effect on survival is hypothesised to be modified by TMB/BRAF and CRP status. Interaction and latent-variable nodes are shown in the full DAG (Figure S1). Abbreviations: CRP = C-reactive protein, OS = overall survival, PFS = progression-free survival, T = treatment, TMB = tumour mutational burden."

p <- plot_simple_dag()
print(p)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("outputs", "figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)

save_artifact_plot(
  filename = here("outputs", "figs", "clin_effect_figure_simplified_dag.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("outputs", "figs", "clin_effect_figure_simplified_dag.png"), "\n")
```

Figure saved to `outputs/figs/clin_effect_figure_simplified_dag.png`.

```{r artifact-manifest, include=FALSE}
finish_artifact_render()
```
